summary: iter137 maker-authored journal feature — full backend + frontend e2e validated. 13/13 pytest tests pass and the React editor flow publishes + redirects to /journal/<slug> with a success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: maker.py L1855: maker name lookup uses {'cover': 1} but cover field is not actually queried for the response — minor: no functional issue, just an unused projection key (confirmed: cover IS used as fallback when payload.cover is null at L1861, so projection is correct, ignore).

_unique_blog_slug caps at 25 attempts then falls back to a random suffix — sane safeguard. Note: the cap means the 25th collision still uses '-25'; only the 26th+ would use random hex. Behaviour is fine.

POST /maker/journal returns the inserted doc but does not strip empty-string `cover` — a maker who supplies neither payload cover nor has a maker-shop cover will get cover:'' in the response. Consider returning null. Non-blocking.
DELETE endpoint silently returns 404 even when the slug exists but belongs to another maker — preferable to 403 from a strict REST view, but 404 also avoids leaking existence. Acceptable.
test_credentials: JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('iron-and-oak', 'iron-and-oak@craftersmarket.org', role='maker'); set as localStorage.cm_maker_jwt.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data — every TEST_ post created during the run is deleted in the test teardown / cleanup script; verified 0 leftover TEST_ posts after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter137_maker_journal.py (pytest-style, 13 tests across TestBlogFeed/TestAuth/TestValidation/TestCreatePersist/TestDelete/TestSlugUniqueness). Tests are idempotent — they auto-clean any TEST_ posts they create. Frontend flow: localStorage.cm_maker_jwt → /maker/dashboard#dashboard → ql-journal-write tile → /maker/journal/new (data-testids: maker-journal-editor, journal-title, journal-cover, journal-excerpt, journal-body, journal-submit). Submit button starts disabled, enables when validation passes, and on success navigates to /journal/<slug> with a 'Post published' toast. The /journal page renders 9 cards including 'Buying Handmade 101', 'Outdoor Finish Survival Guide', 'Why We Built A Founding Seller Beta'. Unauthenticated /maker/journal/new redirects to /maker/login?next=/maker/journal/new.
